title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode4 Secret Practice

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great! That time was perfect!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think I'll run through it once more.
I'm still a little worried about the key change before the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I sure hope those girls come to visit soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I still need to help them all find their true feelings before we can sing together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I just hope performing together as a band again will help them rediscover those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll need to practice even harder if I'm going to be any help. I'm kind of like everyone's senior in this place, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm... A senior... More like a senpai...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder if maybe I should start acting more like one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But how do I do that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When I think of a senpai, I imagine someone more composed. Someone you can rely on whenever you need advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe someone like Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, you're letting yourself get ahead of the beat. Try feeling the rhythm with your body more.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was great.
Let's try doing that again so you can remember exactly how it feels.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. If I can be more like Luka, I'd really give off a senpai vibe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ahem. Are you ready, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're having trouble with your vibratos?
Try to steady your picking a little and see if that helps.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Watch me. When your picking is nice and steady... See? Your vibratos will sound much cleaner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This doesn't feel very senpai-ish...
It just feels like I'm giving a lesson.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wonder if it's the way I talk.
Maybe if I talk more like a grown-up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You see? Picking this way allows you to play a much more beautiful vibrato.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's a little better, but now it just sounds like I'm trying to imitate Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm... How do I make myself seem more like a senpai?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You want to improve your vibratos?
How splendid!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's not right either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eep! L-Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It sounded like you were talking to yourself.
Is everything all right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I'm fine! I was, uh, just practicing! Nothing to see here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Heh.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Calm down. There's no need to get so flustered. If you don't want to tell me, I won't pry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, right there! That's the senpai vibe!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Senpai vibe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing! F-Forget I said anything!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. If something is bothering you, you know you can talk to me, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm here to help whenever you need it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know! Thanks for worrying about me, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I think it's going to take a little longer for me to get the hang of this senpai thing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Luka. What do you think of when you hear the word senpai?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Senpai? Hm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Someone who's good at listening and relating to others, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think people are only able to become senpai because they have others around them who ask them for help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. You're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case, I really hope I can meet those girls soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Once I do, I can become an even better senpai. Then I'll really be able to help them find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. I hope we can meet them soon as well.
